propositions: Hand-maintained help artifacts are stale relative to current parser factory grammar (e.g., show.txt lists wrong options, list.txt includes `--no-pull` absent from build_list())
Help rendering must occur before operation composition, config parsing, store mount, or handler resolution to enable lexical pre-scan with global syntax and command identity
Generated help/*.txt artifacts must be deterministic, byte-identical across runs, with only the capitalized 'Usage:' prefix preserved from argparse defaults
Parser factories in _parsers/core/ and _parsers/advanced/ lack per-argument help= text and descriptions, requiring enrichment so generator can render curated prose without hand-authored concatenation
Overview must uniquely list visible canonical commands once, with exact aliases annotated and hidden routes omitted, and fail --check on any blank command summary or stray/stale artifact
